Asset type: neutral game material diffuse ingredient for fired-clay brick FACES only. No letters, words, numbers, logos, hardware, objects, borders or watermark. Edge-to-edge material colour. The game material recipe will author actual brick dimensions, joints, independent physical relief and roughness; do not paint any of them into this colour ingredient.
scope: Diffuse ingredient only, not registered or installed. Physical brick courses, joints, roughness and independent surface relief still require native authoring and review.
